name: Tianrong Chemical Industry Tbk
summary: PT Tianrong Chemicals Industry Tbk operates as a holding company, with a core focus on the provision of specialized materials. Its business activities are divided into four primary segments: Resin, Plasticizer (DOP), Acrylamide, and Phthalate. Established on December 16, 2003, the company's main office is situated in Jakarta, Indonesia.
